source.url: https://www.hk01.com/突發/60395659/十一黃金周-尖沙咀兩間麥當勞凌晨爆滿-內地人佔多數-氣氛熱鬧

summary.en: Two 24-hour McDonald's outlets in Tsim Sha Tsui were packed in the early hours of October 2 as National Day Golden Week visitors flooded in; most customers were mainland tourists eating, using their phones or chatting, with some resting. The Travel Industry Council said about 270,000 mainland visitors arrived in Hong Kong on the first day of the holiday, up about 10% year on year; some visitors said steep hotel prices drove them to linger overnight.
summary.zh_hans: 国庆黄金周首日深夜至凌晨，记者走访尖沙咀北京道及宝勒巷两家麦当劳，全场开放、座无虚席，以内地旅客为主，大部分人在进食、使用手机或聊天，少数人低头休息。有内地客称因酒店太贵而深夜流连。旅游促进会指首日约27万内地旅客访港，较去年同期升约一成。
summary.zh_hant: 國慶黃金周首日深夜至凌晨，記者走訪尖沙咀北京道及寶勒巷兩間麥當勞，全場開放、座無虛席，以內地旅客為主，大部分人在進食、使用手機或聊天，少數人低頭休息。有內地客稱因酒店太貴而深夜流連。旅遊促進會指首日約27萬內地旅客訪港，較去年同期升約一成。

title.en: Golden Week rush: Tsim Sha Tsui McDonald's outlets packed past midnight with mainland visitors

title.en: Man with dual Iranian-British nationality arrested over foiled attack plot at UK airbase

summary.en: A tour bus and a bus collided head-on on the Aswan–Abu Simbel road in southern Egypt on October 1 local time, injuring 12 people, including nine Chinese nationals and three Egyptians. The injured were taken to hospital for treatment.

summary.zh_hant: 當地時間10月1日，埃及南部阿斯旺至阿布辛貝公路發生旅遊巴與巴士迎面相撞事故，12人受傷，包括9名中國公民及3名埃及人，傷者已送院救治。

title.en: Egypt tour bus crash injures 12, including 9 Chinese nationals

summary.en: US officials said more warships, including a carrier strike group and an amphibious ready group, are heading to the Middle East, further expanding the American military presence in the region. The move comes as the US-Iran conflict continues and Washington weighs possible further military action.
summary.zh_hans: 美国官员表示，包括航空母舰战斗群及两栖戒备群在内的多艘舰艇正前往中东，美军在区内的兵力将进一步增加。背景是美伊冲突持续，美方正评估可能采取的进一步军事行动。
summary.zh_hant: 美國官員表示，包括航空母艦戰鬥群及兩棲戒備群在內的多艘艦艇正前往中東，美軍在區內的兵力將進一步增加。背景是美伊衝突持續，美方正評估可能採取的進一步軍事行動。

title.en: US sends about 9,000 more troops and a third carrier to Middle East as Iran tensions rise

summary.en: Morgan Stanley cut its price target for Apple from US$360 to US$355 while keeping an 'overweight' rating, saying the lower-than-expected pricing of the new iPhone could weigh on average selling price and margins. The bank remains positive on Apple's AI and services outlook; the stock has risen more than 30% in the past six months.
summary.zh_hans: 摩根士丹利将苹果目标价由360美元下调至355美元，维持「增持」评级，指新款iPhone定价低于预期，或拖累平均售价及毛利率；不过该行对苹果AI及服务业务前景仍然乐观。苹果股价过去半年累升逾30%。
summary.zh_hant: 摩根士丹利將蘋果目標價由360美元下調至355美元，維持「增持」評級，指新款iPhone定價低於預期，或拖累平均售價及毛利率；不過該行對蘋果AI及服務業務前景仍然樂觀。蘋果股價過去半年累升逾30%。

title.en: Morgan Stanley trims Apple target price on concerns over cheaper new iPhone pricing

summary.en: After the National Day fireworks display, crowds packed the cross-boundary coach terminus on Austin Road in Tsim Sha Tsui, with up to 500 people queuing at the peak for buses to Huanggang Port; the tail of the queue stretched onto Canton Road. Police were on site to maintain order, which remained generally good.
summary.zh_hans: 国庆烟花汇演后，尖沙咀柯士甸道跨境巴士总站人头涌涌，最高峰时多达500人排队等候乘车往皇岗口岸，龙尾一度伸至广东道。警员到场维持秩序，秩序大致良好。
summary.zh_hant: 國慶煙花匯演後，尖沙咀柯士甸道跨境巴士總站人頭湧湧，最高峰時多達500人排隊等候乘車往皇崗口岸，龍尾一度伸至廣東道。警員到場維持秩序，秩序大致良好。

title.en: Up to 500 queue in Tsim Sha Tsui for cross-border buses after National Day fireworks

summary.en: SpaceX's Dragon spacecraft carrying four astronauts from NASA, the European Space Agency and Russia on the Crew-12 mission lifted off on a Falcon 9 rocket from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39A, heading to the International Space Station for an approximately eight-month mission. The rocket's first stage was successfully recovered.
summary.zh_hans: 美国太空探索技术公司（SpaceX）「龙」飞船搭載美国太空总署、欧洲太空总署及俄罗斯共4名宇航员（Crew-12任务），由猎鹰9号火箭自肯尼迪航天中心39A发射场升空，前往国际空间站执行约8个月任务；发射后一级火箭成功回收。
summary.zh_hant: 美國太空探索技術公司（SpaceX）「龍」飛船搭載美國太空總署、歐洲太空總署及俄羅斯共4名宇航員（Crew-12任務），由獵鷹9號火箭自甘迺迪航天中心39A發射場升空，前往國際太空站執行約8個月任務；發射後一級火箭成功回收。

title.en: SpaceX Dragon ferries new crew of four to International Space Station
